neighbours.label: the category word in a statement about how something should be classed ('best considered a dialect', 'not a vegetable but a fruit', 'in the form of a question'), as against plain descriptions of the same things
fire: Most biologists now agree that the panda is best regarded as a bear.
She phrased her complaint in the form of a suggestion.
Botanically, a peanut is not a nut but a legume.
Experts concluded that the object was best classified as a meteorite.
A whale is not a fish, it is a mammal that breathes air.
Despite the label, this drink is not really a juice at all.
His reply was less an answer than a polite refusal.
Many scholars treat the text as a poem rather than a letter.
quiet: Most biologists now agree that the panda eats mainly bamboo.
She wrote her complaint on a long sheet of paper.
Botanically, a peanut grows underground on a small plant.
Experts concluded that the object fell during the night.
A whale swims thousands of miles every year to feed.
Despite the price, this drink sells well in summer.
His reply arrived by email late on Friday.
Many scholars read the text slowly over several weeks.
